exposure: pathological nuchal translucency (NT) above 3 mm with normal microarray analysis
outcome: composite of complications related to placental pathology (preeclampsia, oligohydramnios, suspected intrauterine growth restriction, abnormal Doppler studies, small for gestational age neonates)
cohort: The study included 185 women with singleton pregnancies, divided into a study group with abnormal nuchal translucency (NT > 3mm) and normal microarray analysis, and a control group with normal NT and normal microarray analysis.
finding: Abnormal nuchal translucency measurements in pregnancies with normal fetal microarray analysis are associated with higher rates of placental-related complications.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age (SGA) neonates were an outcome, implying relevance to birth weight.
gest_age: Small for gestational age (SGA) neonates were an outcome, implying relevance to gestational age.
